title: Conditions: Cancellation and Reinstatement of a CondoGuard Policy
content:
Conditions of the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy on cancellation and reinstatement.

**1. Cancellation for nonpayment.** A notice of cancellation for nonpayment is issued once an installment is still unpaid more than the tier's nonpayment-notice days after its due date. The notice carries a scheduled cancellation date the tier's cancellation-notice days later, and never sooner than the tier's mortgagee notice days when a mortgagee is on file. The notice is rescinded only by payments made before the scheduled date that total at least the amount due as of the notice date.

**2. Amount due.** The amount due on a date is the premium installments due on or before that date, plus the fees, returned payments, additional premium and refunds posted on or before it, less the payments received and return premium posted on or before it, never less than 0.00.

**3. Cancellation by the named insured.** The named insured cancels only by a signed request, and the cancellation is processed only on a request the named insured has signed, as the company's request records show. A named-insured cancellation takes effect no earlier than the date the signed request is received; on or before the effective date of a bound policy it is flat.

**4. Return of premium.** The pro-rata unearned premium is the term premium together with the full-year premium effect of every endorsement of the term whose premium was billed or credited (an endorsement that added premium counted as an increase, one that returned premium as a decrease), multiplied by the calendar days from the cancellation date to the expiration date and divided by the calendar days in the term, rounded half-up to the cent. Under a short-rate basis the carrier keeps the tier's short-rate share of that amount. The credit is the returnable amount less the term's scheduled installments not yet billed, reduced if needed so that the premium kept for the term is at least the tier's minimum earned premium. A negative result is billed as additional premium with the reason cancellation. A carrier cancellation credits pro rata, with no retention and no minimum earned premium.

**5. Reinstatement.** Only a policy cancelled for nonpayment is reinstated, and the reinstatement request is made no later than the reinstatement window that starts on the cancellation date. The window is counted in calendar days from the cancellation date recorded on the policy, and a request on the last day is on time. Reinstatement needs payment of the amount due plus the reinstatement fee, and the named insured's signed statement of no loss since the cancellation date. It is without a lapse, and the cancellation credit is reversed by one additional-premium entry with the reason reinstatement reversal.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- Term premium 730.00 USD, no endorsements, every installment billed, 146 of 365 days left at cancellation: 730.00 multiplied by 146 and divided by 365 is 292.00 USD. On a pro-rata tier the credit is 292.00 USD. On a short-rate tier keeping 10 percent, the returnable amount is 292.00 less 29.20, that is 262.80 USD.
- Reinstatement window of 30 days, policy cancelled for nonpayment on 1 March: the last day is 31 March. A request on 31 March is on time; a request on 1 April is not.
